integrity: The proof and an executable exact-arithmetic checker are embedded. This is a same-model scientific review, not independent validation; historical priority is provisional against inaccessible or unindexed equivalent results.
scientific_limitations: For all fields of characteristic not two and all generator ranks at least two; linear local and linear two-local maps only. The algebra is the nonunital truncated free associative algebra with all ordered products in the tensor square. No result is asserted for nonlinear two-local maps, characteristic two, or general quotients. Small-field computations corroborate but do not replace the proof.
title: Linear local and two-local derivations of free two-step associative algebras
